title: EU okays Kimberly-Clark bid for Neutrogena-owner Kenvue
summary: The European Union on Tuesday, October 13, approved US consumer goods giant Kimberly-Clark USD 48.7-billion purchase of major health company Kenvue after it agreed to divest feminine hygiene brands in Europe to keep them affordable. Texas-based Kimberly-Clark manufactures a wide range of paper and fabric-based products, with brands including Huggies, Kleenex and Kotex.
